In the early days (1996-1999), '''Greco''' played in clan [[TTT]] alongside [[Fnys]] and others, by that time under the nick "''BajZ''". In 1998 [[TTT]] reached 3rd place in the League(?) of 156 playing clans. Later on [[Fnys]] moved to [[Swedish Chefs|SC]] with [[Lakerman]], [[Salmiak]], [[Myst]], amongst others.

Greco attended many LAN tournaments at Cafe9 with (and against) players from [[Clan 9]], clan [[Icon of Pain]] and [[Da Swedish Mob]] and many, many more. He also participated at the time {{player|Death Row|flag=us}} was invited to Cafe 9, back in '98, and was able to play vs players like [[Thresh]], [[Da5id]], [[Reptile]] etc.

After 2001, he went more or less into only sporadically playing QW.

Grecos favourite map in duel is [[dm6]] and he's considered "very" skilled on that map.
